# Three.js

Pinned version: 0.186.1. Source: the official `three` npm package.

`three.min.mjs` bundles `build/three.module.js` and `build/three.core.js` using esbuild 0.25.10 (`--bundle --minify --format=esm`). The MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

This dependency is served locally so the hero does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.
